newsitem.title: UK: Two Brent cargoes kept ahead of deadline - trade.
newsitem.headline: Two Brent cargoes kept ahead of deadline - trade.

text.p: Two Brent cargoes, one nominated loading dates of March 15-17 and one nominated loading dates March 17-19, were kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline on Friday, traders said.
Koch kept the 15-17 loader while JP Morgan kept the 17-19 loader, the traders said.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
